summary: All 64 checks pass against the 39 source issues re-opened, and all 9 area tags fit the issue descriptions. Four points are worth a look but do not fail a check: Sunday CET gives Treat as '$3.4m seed' while Term Sheet and EU-Startups give €3m pre-seed; Techmeme gives the Databricks amount as 'several billion dollars' rather than no amount; Newcomer's 20 Nov issue carries Mailchimp, Isomorphic Labs, Genesis AI, Payhawk and Boltz only as names in its 'Six Notable Deals' line; and the last sentence of the block 5 item (cheaper inference helps application startups and squeezes resellers) is the email's own comment, not stated in any source.
